goal.vector: Dogfooding the planner produces structurally-correct efforts BY CONSTRUCTION: an agent is guided GOAL→Spec→Plan→Tasks and never conflates WHAT with HOW, because the CLI hints and docs make the spec-first (goal-first) path the path of least resistance.
constraints: No CLI path may silently produce a malformed/empty entity (goal POST stored null on a wrong-shape body — must validate)
postulates: Goal defined first, then Spec, then Plan
Goal is mutable and its changes are recorded (working-points), not silently overwritten
